text:
zoe: hi all :wave: Zoe here (joining infra). quick checklist Qs: wheres the authoritative service owner map and escalation contacts? i tried the Confluence link and got a 403. also blocked on VPN/Vault tokens, and if a pager fires before im fully onboarded who do i page for coverage? finally, how do i reserve GPUs for early testing?

marcus (sre): welcome Zoe! the canonical owner map is Confluence -> Team Directory -> Service Owners. if you cant access it we can add you; ping people-ops with your employee email. for urgent coverage: post in #eng-oncall with subject "coverage request - <service> - <brief reason>" and include a contact. someone will pick it up. if no ack in ~10 minutes, escalate to the EM oncall listed next to the service in the owner map.

luis (eng-platform): hi Zoe  we also publish a machine-readable export at https://redwood.internal/api/owners.json that includes primary PD contacts and EM fallbacks. codeowners live per-repo at `.github/CODEOWNERS`; we keep a repo->service mapping in the owners API. i can grant you Confluence read and API access now if you DM your work email.

people-ops: @zoe welcome! i'll send the onboarding checklist to your inbox and add Confluence + facilities requests. temporary badge requests go to facilities@redwood.com (cc people-ops) and usually process within 24h. i'll also add GPU reservations to your checklist (link to reservations page is in the owner map).

security: @zoe for VPN/Vault run `vpn-client login` and `vault login -method=oidc`. if you get "permission denied" it's because your security role hasn't been attached yet. reply here with your employee email and i'll start the approval. note: write access to secrets requires manager + security ack.

zoe: thanks — the Confluence 403 was the main blocker. also saw this when trying to reserve a GPU: "reservation denied: user not in eng-infra group".

luis (eng-platform): i just added you to the eng-infra group and kicked a Confluence invite. try the reservation link after a few minutes; group syncs can take ~5m. if it still errors, paste the reservation command/URL and i'll debug.

marcus (sre): quick escalation note for your first week: if a prod alert hits and you dont have PD access, do the #eng-oncall coverage flow and then DM the EM for your squad. we treat new hires as potential responders but never expect them to act without access — coverage exists for that reason.

devex-bot: Access tasks created: AT-20260504-210 (Confluence invite), AT-20260504-211 (eng-infra group add), AT-20260504-212 (VPN/Vault role grant). ETA 1 business day for manual approvals.

zoe: perfect — appreciate the quick responses everyone :thumbsup: will DM my email now and follow up if anything else pops up.
